notes.title: [HOTFIX - 1.0.2.2] Beyond Galaxyland Update: Steam Deck Verified + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]HOTFIX: Version: 1.0.2.2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Enter' key wasn't functioning properly during dialogue choices.
[*] Increased the deadzone for navigation sticks when flying the ship in space.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883263/9b68b683e480fcef5227d9f2c24b75bdfe7b3095.png[/img]
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

We’ve got exciting news to share! [i]Beyond Galaxyland[/i] has officially been [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b], and we’ve just rolled out a new patch to improve the gameplay experience. Whether you’re exploring on your Steam Deck at home, or enjoying the game elsewhere, these updates are designed to enhance your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883263/e695190ab3c85b7f5d344b6ba8719ef74f552c9e.png[/img]
[h2]Steam Deck Verified![/h2]
We’re thrilled to announce that Beyond Galaxyland is now fully [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]! After resolving a minor UI issue, the game has officially earned this status, meaning you can now experience smooth and seamless gameplay on your Steam Deck.

[b]Enjoy the Full Experience on Steam Deck[/b]
With responsive controls and great performance, Beyond Galaxyland plays beautifully on Steam Deck, whether you're at home or on the go. We’re also proud to share that the game received a [b]5/5 star review[/b] from [b]Steam Deck HQ[/b] for its Deck performance! [url=https://steamdeckhq.com/game-reviews/beyond-galaxyland/]Check out their full review here.[/url]

[b]Share Your Steam Deck Adventure[/b]
We’d love to see your Beyond Galaxyland moments! Share your screenshots or gameplay stories with us on social media or the Steam Discussion forums.

[h2]Latest Patch Notes: Version 1.0.2.0[/h2]
Alongside Steam Deck verification, we've also released a patch to address key issues and improve gameplay, in particular on [b]PlayStation DualShock and DualSense functionality[/b], to enhance your experience:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Rocket Launcher not carrying over to NG+.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] characters falling out of bounds when using the Arcos lift to the surface.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] PlayStation controller not being supported.
[*] [b]Changed[/b] the layout of the Arcadia Cliffside East platforming section.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Crafting 101 not updating properly when collecting Rope.
[*] [b]Adjusted[/b] the duration of Slow and Haste status effects.
[*] [b]Changed[/b] the 'X' icon when using a PlayStation controller.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the ribbon being cut off when saving to another slot on Steam Deck.
[*] [b]Added[/b] 2 new options in Gameplay: Flash Reduction and Ignore Rumble.

[/list][b]Launch Sale Still Ongoing[/b]
Don’t miss out on the chance to grab Beyond Galaxyland at a [b]20% discount[/b] during our [b]limited-time launch sale[/b], which ends this coming Tuesday (October 8th). It’s the perfect opportunity to jump into the adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543710/Beyond_Galaxyland?snr=2___

Thanks again for your continued support! We’re excited to hear your feedback, and we’ll see you in Galaxyland!

[b]- United Label Team[/b]
